be surprised verb

also surprised, amazed, wonder at, marvel, no wonder, it’s no wonder, I’m not surprised, and no wonder, seven wonders of the world

classical

Traupman 388

mīror, mīrārī

verb, first conjugation, deponent

be surprised, amazed

Other words

  • nec mīrum — and no wonder; it is not surprising

    phrase · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 9.14.2: nec mīrum; Cic. Fam. 16.15.2; Traupman 111, 408

    Said after the fact it explains. Also nīl mīrum (Cic. Att. 16.1.3) and quid mīrum? (Cic. Div. 2.81).

Examples

  • accēpī tuam epistulam vacillantibus litterulīs, nec mīrum tam gravī morbō.

    I have had your letter in shaky handwriting, and no wonder, after so serious an illness.Cic. Fam. 16.15.2

  • septem mīrācula mundī

    the seven wonders of the worldTraupman 408

See also wonder.
